component.name: TVTime

Label.text: Time to turn the TV off

component.script:
function init() m.top.setFocus(true) m.statusLabel = m.top.findNode("statusLabel") m.timeDisplay = m.top.findNode("timeDisplay") m.timeLabel = m.top.findNode("timeLabel") m.minutesLabel = m.top.findNode("minutesLabel") m.limitLabel = m.top.findNode("limitLabel") m.errorLabel = m.top.findNode("errorLabel") m.loadingLabel = m.top.findNode("loadingLabel") m.mainLayout = m.top.findNode("mainLayout")
m.port = CreateObject("roMessagePort") m.top.observeField("serverAddress", m.port) m.top.observeField("timeRemaining", m.port) m.top.observeField("error", m.port) m.top.observeField("isLimitHit", m.port) m.top.observeField("discovering", m.port)
' Initialize UI state - show discovering m.top.discovering = true UpdateUI() end function
function UpdateUI() isLimitHit = m.top.isLimitHit hasError = m.top.error <> "" isDiscovering = m.top.discovering timeRemaining = m.top.timeRemaining
' Hide all views first m.timeDisplay.visible = false m.limitLabel.visible = false m.errorLabel.visible = false m.loadingLabel.visible = false m.statusLabel.visible = false
if isDiscovering m.loadingLabel.visible = true else if hasError m.errorLabel.visible = true m.errorLabel.text = "Backend Server Not Found" + chr(10) + m.top.error else if isLimitHit m.limitLabel.visible = true else m.timeDisplay.visible = true m.minutesLabel.text = timeRemaining.ToStr() + " minutes"
if timeRemaining > 30 m.minutesLabel.color = "0x00FF00FF" ' Green else if timeRemaining > 10 m.minutesLabel.color = "0xFFA500FF" ' Orange else m.minutesLabel.color = "0xFF0000FF" ' Red end if end if end function
function onFieldChanged(msg as object) as void field = msg.GetField() if field = "serverAddress" or field = "timeRemaining" or field = "error" or field = "isLimitHit" or field = "discovering" UpdateUI() end if end function
